_read_me: Inputs for evals/unit_economics.py. 'measured' numbers come from the eval logs, not from here. Every value below is an ASSUMPTION until confirmed: replace it with your own figure and keep the source.

kes_per_usd.source: assumption: approximate KES/USD rate; update on the day

sms_kes_per_part.source: assumption: Africa's Talking Kenya SMS rate per part; confirm in your Africa's Talking dashboard (the live demo records AT's own cost)

sms_parts_per_outcome.source: assumption: a signed advisory is up to 320 characters (2 SMS parts), one language

advisories_per_farmer_per_month.source: assumption: about one signed advisory a week during a season

price_kes_per_farmer_per_month.source: TALO's price. Kept low because Dennis and Wilson (Murang'a officers) said paying is 50/50 and depends on value; payers: their organisation or NGOs such as One Acre Fund

pilot_farmers.source: assumption: a first pilot group of 500 farmers in one Murang'a ward (officers there serve about 13,000)

server_usd_per_month.source: assumption: one CPU server (e.g. a small VPS or a mini PC) running the local model, the API and the database

server_utilisation.source: assumption: share of the month the server is busy drafting

officer_review_minutes.source: estimate from the measured draft: ~129 words read at ~200 words a minute (about 40 s) plus checking 5 cited sources (about 2 min). For comparison, careful review of a short AI-drafted email is put at 45-90 s (firstsales.io, unmeasured). Measure it with Dennis and Wilson in the pilot

user_cost_today_kes.source: computed below as the cheapest single loss: one spray washed off by rain (pesticide + a day of labour). See 'What advice is worth to a farmer' in FACT_SHEET.md for the others

maize_bags_per_acre.source: conservative low end: national average 22 bags (90 kg) per acre (KALRO/MoA survey, Dec 2025); a Murang'a (Kiharu) farmer reports 17-24 (The Star, Apr 2026)

maize_kes_per_bag.source: farm-gate price per 90 kg bag, KES 2,800-3,250 in Nov 2025 (Nation / Milling MEA reports); NCPB buys at 3,500

pesticide_kes_per_acre.source: FAW insecticide for one acre: KES 350 per 50 ml bottle, about 20 knapsack pumps per acre (Standard, Machakos farmer); Egerton estimate KES 1,500 per acre

labour_kes_per_day.source: agricultural minimum wage, unskilled, KES 385.24 a day (Regulation of Wages (Agricultural Industry) (Amendment) Order 2026, Grant Thornton wages guide 2026)

faw_loss_share.source: Fall Armyworm cost Kenya about a third of its maize: 37% (2017), 33% (2018), De Groote et al. 2020, 1,439 farmers in 121 communities

planting_gain_low.source: optimal planting time: +7-10% yield overall (Black et al., Frontiers in Climate 2023; Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Zambia, Malawi)

planting_gain_late.source: optimal planting time: up to +20% for farmers who plant late (same study)

draft_words_measured.source: measured: farmer message + rationale of a TALO draft in data/database.db (1 draft; re-measure on the pilot), with 5 cited sources

officer_review_hours_per_week.source: assumption: one working day a week at the desk; the rest stays field work. No published time-use study of Kenyan extension officers was found
